title: UK Blu-rays of Clevatess and Kaiju Mission No. 8 Film Will Be Released on Monday
content:
The story begins with Alicia — who has aspired to be a brave hero since she was little — after she has been chosen by the king to be one of 13 heroes for a quest. Wielding legendary swords, the heroes set out to subjugate the lord of magical beasts, Clevatess . However, these very heroes might bring about the realm's deadliest catastrophe that would wipe out all humanity. The world's last remaining hope lies in a baby entrusted to the lord of magical beasts.

Kiyotaka Taguchi (kaiju designer for SSSS.Dynazenon film) directed the anime at Lay-duce . Keigo Koyanagi ( Brave Bang Bravern! , The Rising of The Shield Hero ) was in charge of series scripts, Souichirou Sako ( Buddy Daddies , Magi: Adventure of Sinbad ) designed the characters, and Nobuaki Nobusawa ( Mr. Villain's Day Off , Police in a Pod , Steins;Gate 0 ) composied the music.

Iwahara ( Darker than Black character designer, King of Thorn manga creator) launched the manga on the LINE Manga app in August 2020. Kadokawa started serializing the manga on its Comic Alive+ website in April 2024.

" Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon is a 2025 recap film that condenses the events of the anime's first season. In a Kaiju-filled Japan, Kafka Hibino works in monster disposal. After reuniting with childhood friend Mina Ashiro, a rising star in the anti-Kaiju Defense Force, he pursues his abandoned dream until he transforms into “ Kaiju No. 8 .”

The first season of Kaiju No. 8 premiered on TV Tokyo on April 13, 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. Shigeyuki Miya ( Onihei ) and Tomomi Kamiya directed the anime. Ichirō Ōkouchi ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion ) handled the series composition and screenplay. Tetsuya Nishio ( Naruto ) was the character designer and chief animation director. Mahiro Maeda ( Shin Godzilla ) designed the monsters. Shinji Kimura ( Tekkonkinkreet ) was the art director. Yūta Bandō ( BELLE ) composed the music.

Production I.G ( Ghost in the Shell ) handled animation production, and Studio Khara ( Rebuild of Evangelion ) was in charge of kaiju designs and artworks.

Muse India describes the anime:

"Kenzaburo Tondabayashi, a 52-year-old diligent public employee, died after a traffic incident… Or that was what's supposed to happen. When he wakes up, he finds himself reincarnated as a character from the world of the Otome game that his daughter loves, "Magical Academy Love & Beast". He is reincarnated as Grace Auvergne, the villainess who obstructs the love life of the game's protagonist, Anna Doll. And so, Grace Kenzaburo tries to act like a villainess just like how the original Grace was. However, due to his life experience, he views Anna through the eyes of a parent and gives her advice. Along with his "Elegant Cheat" which translates his plebeian manner into something elegant, he inadvertently raises his popularity and raises the flags of the capture targets. The weapon you need to survive in another world is not swords or magic, but the Old Man Skill that one has cultivated through living in society!"

The manga centers on Tsukasa, a normal salaryman who is attacked one night by demons, and is saved by a genius kunoichi named Shizuri. In her off time though, Shizuri is a lazy otaku NEET. Tsukasa and Shizuri end up living together, with Tsukasa using his homemaking skills to pamper Shizuri as she continues to serve as his bodyguard.

Hisashi Saitō ( Bamboo Blade , Haganai , Heaven's Lost Property ) directed the anime at Quad . Takashi Aoshima ( Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! , The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ) oversaw the series scripts, Masahiko Suzuki ( Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs ) designed the characters, and CMJK (theme songs for Eyeshield 21 , Puzzle & Dragons X ) composed the music. REAL AKIBA BOYZ loves Shōko Nakagawa , a group consisting of Nakagawa and the b-boy dance unit REAL AKIBA BOYZ , performed the opening theme song "Neet In Jam🍓."

"Jiraiya's fate weighs heavily on Naruto 's young heart, but his sorrow turns to determination as he tries to solve Jiraiya's mysterious message. Then the unthinkable happens - the godlike Pain passes through the Leaf's defences and attacks the village directly!"
author: ANN

title: Kaiju Decode: The Ring of Aidara Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for Tsuburaya Productions and Toei Animation 's Kaiju Decode CG anime project revealed a teaser trailer, a new teaser visual, and the 2027 debut for Kaiju Decode: The Ring of Aidara ( Kaiju Decode: Aidara no Yubiwa ), on Sunday.

• Aya Yamane as Maru, a boy from the City

• Karin Takahashi as Coco, a girl of the Aidara tribe who lives in the dangerous Zone where beasts are found

The new anime takes place in Sakai in Osaka prefecture. Katsuie Shibata ( Hitchhiker's Guide to the Isekai ) is writing the screenplay. Masayuki Gotou ( SSSS.Dynazenon ) is designing the monsters. Hollywood CG art director Sei Nakashima ( Mewtwo Strikes Back Evolution end credits illustrations, Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone concept artist) is the character designer for Maru. Masatsugu Saitō ( Cyborg 009 Call of Justice ) is the designer for Coco. JNTHED ( Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ) illustrated the teaser visual (pictured right).

The project's theme is "a story about kaiju and girls," and the studios are aiming the project at a worldwide audience.

A full anime short for Kaiju Decode streamed in December 2021 on the Tsuburaya Imagination website. The companies also released a VR anime short titled Kaiju Decode : First Contact on the same day for Oculus Quest. Both anime are listed as the "first part" of the overall project.

S/N directed the anime at Arect . Tetsuya Yamada wrote the script, and Tadahiko Inoue composed the music. The anime stars Nobunaga Shimazaki as Rei, Marika Kōno as Miru, Mayumi Shintani as Zora, and Aya Yamane as Real Rei.

The producers for the project include Kōichi Noguchi and Masahiro Onda . Noguchi is the producer of such anime as Expelled from Paradise and KADO - The Right Answer , while Onda is a veteran Tsuburaya Productions producer for such projects as Ultraman Zero: The Revenge of Belial , as well as an executive producer on the SSSS.Gridman anime series. Sei Nakashima is the character designer.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Reveals English Dub Cast, Staff for 2nd Seasons of Black Clover, Aoashi Anime
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Saturday the cast and staff members, and the release date for the English dub of the second season of the Black Clover and Aoashi series.

The first English dub episode for the second anime season based on Yūki Tabata 's Black Clover manga started streaming on Saturday. New episodes will stream weekly.

The English dub cast includes:

• Dallas Reid as Asta

• Micah Solusod as Yuno

• Bryce Papenbrook as Liebe

• Max Mittelman as Nacht

• T.J. Anthony as Albert

• Colleen Clinkenbeard as Charlotte

• Patrick Seitz as Dante

• Jad Saxton as Dorothy

• J. Michael Tatum as Fuegoleon

• Ray Chase as Gimodelo

• Justin Cook as Jack

• Robert McCollum as Julius

• Sonny Strait as King Clover

• Clifford Chapin as Langris

• Brad Hawkins as Lotus

• Quinn Angell as Makusa

• Monica Rial as Mereoleona

• Tom Aglio as Morgen

• Chuck Huber as Morris

• Cris George as Narrator

• Ricco Fajardo as Nozel

• Bryan Massey as Rades

• Keith Silverstein as Ralph

• Derick Snow as Rill

• Trina Nishimura as Sally

• Garret Storms as Sekke

• Christopher Guerrero as Valtos

• Zeno Robinson as Zenon

English dub staff members are:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Susie Nixon

• Adaptation: Bonny Clinkenbeard

• Adaptation Prep: Benjamin Tehrani

• Voice Director: Jason Lord

• Assistant Voice Director: Ryan Negrón

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: August Cline

• Mixer: Rickey Watkins

The second anime season of Black Clover debuted on October 3 on TV Tokyo and its affiliates at 11:00 p.m. JST. The anime streams in Japan on Anime Times , Lemino , U-NEXT , and Anime Hōdai . Crunchyroll streams the anime as it airs.

WANIMA performs the opening theme song "Kienai Riyū" (The Reason that Won't Disappear). ONE OR EIGHT performs the ending theme song "Yellow Brick Road."

The Black Clover anime last aired in March 2021 with its 170th episode.

The anime premiered in Japan in October 2017. The show was originally listed with 51 episodes, but it continued into a new season with episode 52 in October 2018, and continued on again into a new season in October 2019. Crunchyroll streamed the series in Japanese with English subtitles, and Funimation streamed the show's English dub . The anime debuted on Adult Swim 's Toonami programming block in December 2017.

The first English dub episode for the second season of Yūgo Kobayashi 's Aoashi manga streams on Sunday.

English dub cast members include:

• Ciarán Strange as Ashito

• Eric Vale as Fukuda

• Garret Storms as Kuribayashi

• Christopher Llewyn Ramirez as Ohtomo

• Ernesto Jason Liebrecht as Taira

• Marcus D. Stimac as Togashi

• Molly Zhang as Anri

• Ry McKeand as Kuroda

• David Matranga as Yoshitsune

• Aaron Campbell as Matsunaga

• Brienne Olvera as Akutsu

• Ethan Gallardo as Kiriki

• Christopher Wehkamp as Takasugi

• Ricco Fajardo as Yuma

• Oscar Seung as Akiyama

• Daryl Mayfield as Mito

• Kit Lozano as Miyako

• Douglas Gill as Tsukishima

• Eli Farmer as Osieck

• Jacob Hopkins as Yamada

• Clifford Chapin as Tachibana

• Jordan Kendrick as Baba

• Marisa Duran as Hana

• Nic Hamill as Shimura

• Marianne Bray as Emi

• Kelly Greenshield as Midori

• Jamal Sterling as Benzen

Additional voices include Abigail Blythe , Skye Redden , Jordan Kendrick , and Nic Hamill .

The English dub staff members are:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Susie Nixon

• Adaptation Supervisor: Bonny Clinkenbeard

• Adaptation: Domonique French

• Adaptation Prep: Derric Benavides

• Voice Director: Shawn Gann

• Assistant Voice Director: Kevin D. Thelwell

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Derric Benavides

• Assistant Engineer: Katie Saltkill

• Mixer: Nathanael Harrison

The second season of Aoashi debuted on NHK Educational on October 4. Crunchyroll streams the anime as it airs.

10-FEET perform the opening theme song "Fortress Defense," while Ai Higuchi performs the ending theme song "Triangle."

The first season of the anime premiered in April 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Kobayashi ( Fermat no Ryōri ) launched the Aoashi manga in Weekly Big Comic Spirits in January 2015, and ended it with its 40th compiled book volume in August 2025. Naohiko Ueno is credited for research and original story collaboration up to the manga's 17th volume. The series won the Best General Manga at the 65th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2020. Titan Manga is releasing the manga in English in omnibus format, and it released the first 3-in-1 omnibus volume on June 9. The series has over 15 million copies in circulation .

title: Naruto’s New Manga Has Already Revealed What It’s Really About, and You Probably Missed It
content:
While fans hope Naruto ’s new manga will focus on Naruto and Team 7, it might be about the next generation instead. Ever since the original creator announced Naruto’ s new manga at the recent New York Comic Con, fans have naturally been looking forward to seeing what Kishimoto has planned for the beloved original characters. Meanwhile, fans are worried that the new manga could make the sequel, Boruto , irrelevant, while fans of the sequel fear it could overshadow Boruto and prevent the series from receiving the attention it deserves.

However, the new manga, Naruto: Shadow Rising , could instead do the opposite. The teaser revealed that the series will focus on the period after the events of Shippuden and before Naruto became Hokage. This suggests that the series will follow Naruto’s journey toward becoming Hokage, advancing through the ranks, and possibly going on missions alongside Sakura and his other teammate, Sasuke, with Team 7 back on missions under Kakashi’s guidance. While these events could be featured, the new manga’s main focus could actually be bridging the gap between Naruto and the next generation, and the teaser also hints that it will focus on Boruto and the next generation.

Naruto ’s New Manga Could Officially Bridge the Gap to Boruto

When the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations manga first came out, many Naruto fans dismissed the idea, and their skepticism was amplified by the fact that Masashi Kishimoto wasn’t writing the series. This even led many to call it non-canon. However, the original creator returned as the manga’s writer after it reached 50 chapters . This means Kishimoto sees its potential, even though Boruto wasn’t his original idea for the franchise. Now, he might be planning to officially bridge the gap between the two generations with this new installment of the Naruto manga, as the original series never explored the transition to the next generation.

The teaser for Naruto: Shadow Rising now hints that the manga could focus on filling this gap. Specifically, the new illustrations showcase Naruto’s Hokage statue being built and Sarada with her newborn daughter. This suggests that the manga will explore events surrounding the period when Naruto and other original characters, including Sasuke and Shikamaru, started having children. With Naruto’s priorities shifting from becoming Hokage for his own sake to caring for others, particularly the next generation, this manga could explore that transition. It could focus on Naruto and his companions navigating parenthood as they work to secure a better future for the next generation.

Considering that Kishimoto is actively working on Boruto: Two Blue Vortex , which is also at a crucial point, he might be using this new series to draw more attention to Boruto . With the possibility of Naruto returning in the sequel , Kishimoto could use this manga to lay the groundwork for Naruto’s role in future events, hinting at what awaits the next generation and why Boruto and his generation are crucial to overcoming those challenges. The announcement of Naruto ‘s new manga was certainly unexpected, but these elements suggest that it could be part of a larger plan to strengthen Boruto ‘s story.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen’s Gojo Satoru Finally Becomes No. 1 in the One Way That Matters Most
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s Satoru Gojo has an even better quality than simply being the strongest, and he is finally being appreciated for it. There is no denying that Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s emergence as one of the most popular modern shonen series is largely thanks to Gojo. The blue-eyed sorcerer has become one of the most prominent characters in the anime industry, standing alongside Goku, Naruto, and Luffy despite being a side character. His charm, presence, and status as the strongest made him the character he is today. However, Gojo failed to live up to his reputation as the strongest after being defeated.

However, fans often fail to realize that Gojo’s charm as the strongest is only his second-best quality , while his most important trait is what his character stands for in the series: being a teacher. Gojo is a teacher through and through, and it is something he takes pride in. His students, Yuta, Yuji, Megumi, and the others have always appreciated this aspect of his character. This is what matters most to Gojo’s character, and a recent poll has revealed that fans are appreciating this side of him as well.

Gojo Finally Claims an Important No. 1 Spot That Defines His Character

In celebration of World Teachers’ Day, Anime!Anime! , a Japanese anime news and media website, asked fans which anime characters come to mind when they think of teachers. The votes put Gojo at No. 1, earning him the title of best teacher. Gojo received 16% of the votes, marking a major victory as he finally secured the top spot after four years of being outperformed by other characters in this category. What makes this achievement even more interesting is that Gojo had consistently ranked second for the past four years.

The No. 1 spot for best teacher in this poll had always been claimed by none other than Koro-sensei from Assassination Classroom . The alien-like teacher had held this position for six consecutive years, but he has finally been dethroned by Gojo, with the blue-eyed sorcerer receiving two percentage points more votes than Koro-sensei. This is a victory Gojo needed far more than being recognized as the strongest, as his character has always been defined by his role as a teacher. Gojo has always taken pride in this aspect of his identity, embracing even the most difficult opportunities to teach his students whenever he could.

Gojo’s confidence in his teaching is what makes him such a good teacher, inspiring confidence in his students as well, which is one of the best qualities anyone could hope for. His role in the series also comes to an end with him leaving behind the tools his students need to become stronger and more confident, especially Yuji, in whom Gojo saw potential when others viewed him only as a threat. It is easy to imagine Satoru Gojo as a character defined by his strength, which would make him little more than a cool character. However, his role as a teacher and the way he excels at it are what truly define his characterization in Jujutsu Kaisen . It is nice to see Gojo finally being appreciated for this quality and claiming the No. 1 spot he deserves.

How do you feel about Gojo in this top spot? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Next Big Webtoon Anime Won’t Be Another Solo Leveling, but There’s a Bigger Problem
content:
The webtoon industry is on the rise thanks to several anime adaptations, especially since the popularity of Solo Leveling . Crunchyroll has a huge role to play in giving these anime a major global platform. So far, a majority of the webtoon adaptations have been action fantasies like Solo Leveling and Tomb Raider King . Stories like that usually focus on either an underdog or an overpowered protagonist as they navigate the supernatural world. However, things have slightly begun to change after the recent wave of announcements by Crunchyroll regarding the anime adaptations of webtoons. One of the biggest new projects for next year is The Remarried Empress , a popular romance fantasy full of palace drama.

While the manhwa and light novel have already ended, fans have something new to look forward to next year with the anime debut and the live-action. The anime’s trailer has already been revealed, and it shares a brief glimpse at what to expect from the story. Of course, since the announcement has only been made, it doesn’t reveal all the details regarding the premiere yet. The Remarried Empress will be one of the biggest webtoon adaptations of next year, even though it’s not an action fantasy like Solo Leveling . However, there’s an entirely different reason as to why the series might not be the best choice for an anime.

The Remarried Empress Poorly Portrays Sensitive Themes

As popular as the series is among webtoon readers , it also can’t be denied that the series is hated for all the right reasons. While the light novel and the manhwa started out strong, it didn’t take long for readers to notice the issues with the portrayal of sensitive themes, especially slavery. The majority of the reason why the series gets hate is for villainizing a young slave girl, Rashta, while an older, privileged Empress is the victim. The story glosses over the issues of slavery while treating them as inferior to ordinary citizens, including nobles and commoners. The protagonist, Navier, is portrayed as an Empress with deep love for her kingdom, yet somehow she is indifferent to the slavery system.

Nobles are free to keep slaves and treat them however they want, while the royal family doesn’t do anything for them. This is why her world was shattered when her husband, the Emperor, brought home a Concubine who was formerly a slave. The story doesn’t shy away from villainizing the girl throughout the end, while the Emperor actually got his redemption. While the story stays true to its themes, considering how the royalty will be blind to the suffering of the less privileged, many readers criticize the thoughtless portrayal of such themes. Everyone of the Empress’ allies, even someone whose family owned Rashta as a slave, was keen on ruining the girl’s life because she was scheming.

Stories like that try hard to be seen as dramatic, but the intention behind them is much more problematic than what fans might initially think. It’s pretty rare for romance fantasy webtoons to get an anime adaptation, which is why it’s unfortunate for The Remarried Empress to get one before others. Stories like that will always divide the industry, and an anime will only fuel the dissatisfaction readers have towards it. There are much better webtoons that should’ve gotten an adaptation, but The Remarried Empress is still more popular than them.

What do you think about The Remarried Empress getting an anime adaptation? Or do you have a series in mind that would’ve been a better choice? Let us know in the comments below.

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for Dr. Stone’s Big Anime Sequel
content:
Last week, Dr. Stone confirmed its anime sequel only a few months after the finale. The anime reached its conclusion in June this year, seven years after its debut. The anime is based on an award-winning manga written by Riichiro Inagaki and illustrated by Boichi, which began serialization in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2017. Although the finale unraveled the mystery behind the petrification, it also had an open-ended conclusion after Senku claimed he would build a time machine to stop the tragedy from 3700 years ago. Dr. Stone is one of the most beloved series of all time, thanks to its unique premise and sci-fi elements, which are rare to see in Shonen.

Although initially criticized for an abrupt ending, it remains one of the most critically acclaimed Shonen of all time. Although the main story didn’t have a fleshed-out finale as one might hope for, the story wrapped up after answering all the major questions for fans while also leaving room for future development. While the main story has already reached its conclusion, the anime confirmed last week that it’s returning with a surprise new sequel. Here’s everything you need to know before the anime returns with the epilogue.

3) Dr. Stone ‘s Sequel Hasn’t Confirmed a Release Date Yet

Dr. Stone Terraforming was announced last week as an official sequel to the main story. However, the anime has yet to share updates on the release window. Since the Fall 2026 anime series have already been revealed, the sequel will only be released next year. The announcement was made earlier this month with a promotional video that shares a brief glimpse at everything that has happened in the anime so far. Instead of sharing spoilers on what to expect from the sequel, the teaser only confirms the sequel without a lot of details. While fans await updates on the anime, at the very least, it’s guaranteed that the sequel will land on Crunchyroll. It’s the primary streaming home for the series, where you can catch up with all the seasons. Additionally, the anime is also available on Netflix, where the sequel should land sometime after the official premiere date.

2) The Anime Sequel Will Adapt the Manga Epilogue

In 2023, the manga released a three-chapter-long sequel, following Senku and the main characters. While the story ends after he announced to everyone that he would be building a time machine , the epilogue features the progress of his most ambitious project yet. Titled Dr. Stone: 4D Science , the story gave a brief glimpse at the characters’ journey after the ending. Since the sequel is only three chapters long, it couldn’t be compiled in a single volume, but all chapters are available to read on the official website of Viz Media. The anime can easily return with one or two special episodes to adapt the epilogue, but there has been no confirmation regarding the episode length or the number of episodes. There’s always a possibility that the story will expand in the sequel, especially since Dr. Stone is one of the most famous anime in recent years.

1) Dr. Stone Won’t Be Holding a Panel During the Biggest Annual Convention

While the anime sequel is one of the most exciting upcoming projects in a while, fans will have to wait longer than expected to get new updates. This is mostly because the series won’t be holding a panel during this year’s Jump Festa. It’s the largest annual convention held by Shueisha, as it focuses on new announcements for anime, manga, and games, interactive exhibits, and even unique merchandise that is often available only at the convention. As a Weekly Shonen Jump hit, it would’ve made sense for the series to hold a panel during the Jump Festa 2027, which will be held on December 19th and 20th. While the convention is always held in Tokyo, Japan, fans from all over the world await updates on their favorite anime and manga series. However, the official website confirmed the lineup last month , and it doesn’t include Dr. Stone . This means that there’s a good possibility that the sequel won’t share any new updates this year.

Are you excited for Dr. Stone’s upcoming anime sequel? Head down to the comments to let us know which moment you’re looking forward to in the anime.

title: 6 Years Later, Shonen Jump Rushed to the End of This Anime & Fans Felt It
content:
Shueisha’s Shonen Jump series has dominated the anime and manga industry for several decades now. Most of the popular Shonen series you might have come across are tied to the publisher’s magazines. This is especially the case for Weekly Shonen Jump , a manga magazine that was launched in 1969. It eventually became the best-selling manga magazine thanks to the popularity of several classics such as One Piece, Dragon Ball, Naruto, and more. However, while the magazine is famous for serializing unique and fan-favorite stories over the decades, it also has a history of rushed endings . Creating weekly series for years can often lead to burnout and health issues, which isn’t a secret in the manga industry.

Not to mention that there are rarely times that and ending has been satisfying for fans in Shonen Jump . This is true even for the most beloved series such as Naruto and Bleach . Over the decades, while the series have become shorter, they still face rushed endings and lots of other issues. This also includes Food Wars!: Shokugeki no Soma , which reached its conclusion in 2019. Following the controversial manga finale, the anime also concluded on September 26th, 2020, and it was unable to save the disappointing finale.

Why Is Food Wars!: Shokugeki no Soma Ending Controversial?

Shonen series based on cooking are still rare, especially something like Food Wars that transforms high-pressure cooking into an intense, competitive shonen battle. The story centers around Souma Yukihara, who enrolls in Tootsuki Culinary Academy, a world-renowned school where aspiring chefs deal with intense pressure. Expulsions of incompetent students are common in a place where everything leads to competition. However, due to the intense curriculum, students who do graduate as chefs are recognized for their talents all over the world.

The story follows his journey as he encounters new friends and rivals along the way while trying to surpass his father’s cooking skills. The series had a steady run for the most part, but things changed significantly when the BLUE Arc abandoned its grounded culinary realism. It focused more on overused Shonen tropes by introducing a criminal underworld of dark chefs who wield absurd weapons and possess supernatural-like skills. The assassination training particularly felt off in a series that focused on the protagonist’s culinary journey. Not only that, but the final antagonist, Asahi, got an unearned redemption arc that stole a lot of screentime.

The screentime could’ve been used for the side characters whose potential was wasted in the finale, but that wasn’t the case at all. Another common Shonen gimmick the series followed was the unresolved romance between Sohma and Erina. Shonen Jump series often focus on hints of slow-burn romance without ever solving it in the finale, and it’s disappointing that Food Wars went down the same route, especially since Erina’s feelings for Sohma were quite clear.

Food Wars Anime Made Major Changes in Season 5

Food Wars sparked quite a lot of controversy during its final stretch , and the anime was unable to save fans from disappointment. The series remained faithful to the manga for the most part, but there were several changes in the fifth season. It didn’t adapt the 3-chapter epilogue titled Le Dessert. The epilogue follows the characters a few years after the events of the final arc. Not only that, but the anime also made changes regarding the relationship between Erina and Sohma. While the manga confirmed Erina’s feelings for him, the anime only hinted at them with an altered tone. Among the many disappointing changes, the final season also featured rushed character introductions, especially for Asahi. The anime ended only one year after the manga, which means that the controversy hadn’t died down completely. Unfortunately, it only made things worse for fans with all the unnecessary changes.

Shonen Jump Series Still Can’t Escape Rushed Endings

The many issues with the Food Wars ending aren’t something Shonen fans are unfamiliar with, and it’s disappointing such tropes keep happening even after so many years. Shonen Jump has a long history of disappointing fans at the very end of the story. While a majority of the reason is because of the pressure creators are dealing with, oftentimes, the story also takes an unexpected turn that doesn’t always impress fans. Shonen is a diverse demographic ranging from stories about fantasy, action, adventure, sports, and even slice-of-life. However, the pattern of disappointing endings is a much bigger problem seen in more series. Stories like Fullmetal Alchemist and Mob Psycho 100 are rare and still praised for their well-written conclusions.

Do you think Food Wars! deserved a longer, more satisfying conclusion, or was the ending actually good? Let us know in the comments how you would have liked to see this beloved Shonen Jump series end!

title: 3 Coolest Aura-Farming Moments in Dragon Ball’s History
content:
In the year 2024, the human brain finally concocted a phrase to perfectly encapsulate the pulse-pounding moments from Dragon Ball , “aura farming.” From Goku going Super Saiyan for the first time to original Broly cackling (with lightning striking in the background) as he transforms. Which was so cool it deserved to be canonized. The series is loaded with an abundance of cool scenes, and will have plenty more with the recent additions to Super Saiyan 3 and 4 club .

But for this list, it comes down to just three. There are some criteria that went into each of these picks. First, each moment has to come from a different saga. Second, it has to showcase a different character. And last and most obvious, it’s got to be a major plot point. These moments were a little too close to call, but are some of the coolest moments in Dragon Ball ‘s history.

3) Vegeta Fearlessly Sacrifices Himself

Vegeta has so many scenes where he steals the entire show, and this wasn’t an easy choice considering he broods and drops one-liners nearly every episode. However, his selfless sacrifice in Dragon Ball Z ‘s Buu saga has to take the top of the list. Goku’s reluctant friend takes a page out his fellow Saiyan’s book and gives himself up for his friends and family. Vegeta nearly loses himself in his search to become more powerful than his aforementioned rival. He even allows the evil Babidi to possess him and take on the Majin Vegeta form to try and defeat Goku.

Before he can accomplish that feat, Majin Buu returns and proves too much for the Prince of Saiyans. He finally turns from his wicked ways and decides the only way to defeat the monster is with a self-destruct move. Sporting his famous smirk, Vegeta’s internal thoughts show his development from selfish warrior to compassionate defender of the Earth, “Trunks, Bulma, I do this for you and yes even for you Kakarot.” He then lets out a roar and is absorbed by a powerful energy blast. Although the attack proves fruitless, his bloodied and beat-up look, the Majin ‘M’ and his courageous, heroic turn are iconic.

2) Broly Becomes The Legendary Super Saiyan

Both Broly transformations are the epitome of awesome, but watching the official canon version go through a thousand emotions in a matter of seconds before tearing himself and everything apart in his journey to become a Super Saiyan was too impressive to pass up. Broly is characterized throughout most of the movie as a quiet and gentle soul that contains immense power.

Despite his father Paragus’ demeaning and at-times abusive attitude towards his son, Broly cares for him. Broly battles mightily against Goku and Vegeta, raising his power level at a rapid rate. However, he appears to cap out, so Frieza decides to take matters into his own hands. He kills Paragus and tells Broly that a stray energy blast killed him. This causes Broly to literally lose his mind, making his pupils disappear and descend into an uncontrollable state. He becomes the Legendary Super Saiyan.

A level so strong that even with Goku and Vegeta in Super Saiyan Blue mode they are no match for the hulking Broly. He then ragdolls Golden Frieza for minutes on end, until Goku and Vegeta fuse together into Gogeta stop his rampage . The fight is so powerful that it literally breaks reality itself. The scene gave Dragon Ball fans everything they could’ve hoped for and more.

1) Future Trunks Easily Decimates Mecha Frieza and King Cold

Future Trunks’ introduction is the perfect bait and switch to level the show up. Goku and friends aren’t too far removed from a hellacious bout with Frieza that saw many people die. The fight took everything out of the young Saiyan just to win the first time, so audience knows Frieza is quite formidable.

Just a few episodes later, King Cold finds and rebuilds his son, literally, using cybernetics. King Cold, Frieza and a ship full soldiers go to Earth to get revenge. The look on everyone’s faces is filled with horror, knowing what it just took to defeat Frieza. But now they have to defeat him, his father, and a platoon with Goku still absent. The tension is built so well and then a mysterious, silver-haired fighter arrives and dispatches his soldiers with ease. Still, Frieza and King Cold should prove tough to defeat right? The mystery fighter ascends to a Super Saiyan and proceeds to cut through a power-up Frieza in seconds.

King Cold compliments the young Saiyan that just killed his son, and thinks he can return the favor when he asks to see the sword. He deduces that the sword is the source of Trunks’ strength. King Cold’s suspicions are proven woefully wrong. He attempts to slice into Trunks, who with no effort at all, stops the blade with his hand and walks back the emperor. Cold begs for his life, but with no expression on his face, Trunks shoots a blast through him and then incinerates him and his ship with one final shot.

The setup and payoff are so brilliant. It took more than 100 episodes to get to this point, and we all thought that power levels mattered. In one new appearance, the whole game had officially changed and gone up quite a few notches. What are your favorite aura-farming moments from the Dragon Ball franchise? Leave us some comments and let us know.

contentBlocks.text: In the year 2024, the human brain finally concocted a phrase to perfectly encapsulate the pulse-pounding moments from Dragon Ball , “aura farming.” From Goku going Super Saiyan for the first time to original Broly cackling (with lightning striking in the background) as he transforms. Which was so cool it deserved to be canonized. The series is loaded with an abundance of cool scenes, and will have plenty more with the recent additions to Super Saiyan 3 and 4 club .

But for this list, it comes down to just three. There are some criteria that went into each of these picks. First, each moment has to come from a different saga. Second, it has to showcase a different character. And last and most obvious, it’s got to be a major plot point. These moments were a little too close to call, but are some of the coolest moments in Dragon Ball ‘s history.
3) Vegeta Fearlessly Sacrifices Himself

Vegeta has so many scenes where he steals the entire show, and this wasn’t an easy choice considering he broods and drops one-liners nearly every episode. However, his selfless sacrifice in Dragon Ball Z ‘s Buu saga has to take the top of the list. Goku’s reluctant friend takes a page out his fellow Saiyan’s book and gives himself up for his friends and family. Vegeta nearly loses himself in his search to become more powerful than his aforementioned rival. He even allows the evil Babidi to possess him and take on the Majin Vegeta form to try and defeat Goku.

Before he can accomplish that feat, Majin Buu returns and proves too much for the Prince of Saiyans. He finally turns from his wicked ways and decides the only way to defeat the monster is with a self-destruct move. Sporting his famous smirk, Vegeta’s internal thoughts show his development from selfish warrior to compassionate defender of the Earth, “Trunks, Bulma, I do this for you and yes even for you Kakarot.” He then lets out a roar and is absorbed by a powerful energy blast. Although the attack proves fruitless, his bloodied and beat-up look, the Majin ‘M’ and his courageous, heroic turn are iconic.
2) Broly Becomes The Legendary Super Saiyan

Both Broly transformations are the epitome of awesome, but watching the official canon version go through a thousand emotions in a matter of seconds before tearing himself and everything apart in his journey to become a Super Saiyan was too impressive to pass up. Broly is characterized throughout most of the movie as a quiet and gentle soul that contains immense power.

Despite his father Paragus’ demeaning and at-times abusive attitude towards his son, Broly cares for him. Broly battles mightily against Goku and Vegeta, raising his power level at a rapid rate. However, he appears to cap out, so Frieza decides to take matters into his own hands. He kills Paragus and tells Broly that a stray energy blast killed him. This causes Broly to literally lose his mind, making his pupils disappear and descend into an uncontrollable state. He becomes the Legendary Super Saiyan.

A level so strong that even with Goku and Vegeta in Super Saiyan Blue mode they are no match for the hulking Broly. He then ragdolls Golden Frieza for minutes on end, until Goku and Vegeta fuse together into Gogeta stop his rampage . The fight is so powerful that it literally breaks reality itself. The scene gave Dragon Ball fans everything they could’ve hoped for and more.
1) Future Trunks Easily Decimates Mecha Frieza and King Cold

Future Trunks’ introduction is the perfect bait and switch to level the show up. Goku and friends aren’t too far removed from a hellacious bout with Frieza that saw many people die. The fight took everything out of the young Saiyan just to win the first time, so audience knows Frieza is quite formidable.

title: Marvel’s X-Men, Iron Man & More Reveal First Look at New Webtoon Series
content:
Marvel Comics have been making massive strides in creating innovative new stories for their iconic characters. Aside from the Marvel Cinematic Universe, which remains one of the most popular and lucrative film franchises of all time. Now, the multi-media giant will be jumping back into the foray of manga and webtoons with multiple announcements reimagining existing characters and introducing some new faces to the multiverse. In an exciting post from WEBTOON’s official X (formerly Twitter) account, the web comic platform announced that three original stories centering Marvel will be coming to the platform, including popular heroes like Iron Man and Deadpool.

While there have been no official release date announced for the projects just yet, WEBTOON did offer Marvel fans a look at the official promotional art for each of the new series, including That Time Deadpool Fell Into WEBTOON and Found the Longest Title of All Time , Tony’s Girl , and X-Men Korea . This is far from the first time Marvel Comics has crafted stories designed for vertical platforms, with stories like The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl , Loki: Agent of Asgard , and PEACH MOMOKO’s Ultimate X-Men still being available on the platform.

WEBTOON Is Reinventing Marvel Icons In a Creative New Way

These new web comics will be taking existing Marvel icons — and even introducing a brand-new hero in Yeong-seo Go, the protagonist of X-Men Korea — placing in them in wholly original stories. One of the most intriguing of the three newly-announced projects is Tony’s Girl , written by CRC Payne with art by StarBite that follows a 17-year-old Tony Stark fresh out of MIT who, instead of getting to work at Stark industries after graduating to instead take etiquette classes to repair his public image. There, he meets Meredith McCall, the daughter of his father’s rival, Creighton McCall. Marvel fans may recognize Meredith McCall as she appears in the Iron Man with a rather contradictory history. She’s initially introduced as a woman Tony Stark had history with as a teenager; the pair’s former star-crossed romance seems to be what Tony’s Girl will be exploring.

That Time Deadpool Fell Into WEBTOON…and Found The Longest Title of All Time!!! ‘s title is poking good fun at stereotypical, long-winded isekai and light novel titles, with its plot paying homage to similar tropes. Written by Ucheomaaa with art by Annie Huang, the infamous “merc with a mouth” is sent on an adventure through WEBTOON’s expansive multiverse , trying to find a way home while fighting his way through historical action stories and cheesy romantic dramas. X-Men Korea by Studio LICO will be exploring a brand-new story in the Marvel multiverse, following Yeong-seo Go, a high school student who wakes up one day to discover that he is a mutant. He enrolls in Hoseok Academy for the Gifted and inevitably gets dragged into a major conspiracy to fight for the future of mankind.

Marvel Has Been Dabbling In Manga & Manhwa For Years

Marvel has been collaborating with the manga and manhwa industry for years, and with immense success. One of the most popular of these projects was Deadpool Samurai , written by Sanshiro Kasama and illustrated by Hikaru Uesugi, which follows Deadpool after Iron Man convinces him to move to Japan to become the new leader of the Samurai Squad, a newly formed Japanese branch of the Avengers. Initially published on Shonen Jump +’s digital platform, Deadpool Samurai was immensely successful, quickly surpassing over 1 million views per chapter on the site, with the physical release having over 200,000 copies in circulation.

Spider-Man has made his way into popular Japanese manga franchises as well, having a special crossover with the release of Ultraman: Along Came a Spider-Man . The comic book giant has no plans of slowing down, either, announcing a partnership with Kadokawa at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 confirming that there’s even more to come from Marvel’s journey into new storytelling mediums. With WEBTOON continuing to grow in popularity thanks to its accessibility and variety in genres and storytelling, it’s only a matter of time before Marvel’s latest projects being published through the service begin taking the world by storm.

Which of these Marvel Comics Webtoons are you looking forward to the most? Which Marvel hero would you want to see make their debut next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
